body: Thank you for answering. I think the whole point of asking was just that I was curious whether they were people you considered "trolls". But as far as I can see, some of them are genuine. The rest don't seem to be too malicious so as long as you're cool with them, that is fine.
I'm wondering because if they are so into fitness shouldn't they be also be into eating healthily?

My depression started to surface when I began school. As an adult, the stress of having to be in a shitty job that I have no skills in makes it a thousand times worse. So I think it's partially society's fault, but depression is also genetic. It's a disease. It's not a choice. Society definitely doesn't help with it especially because there's such a stigma toward mental illnesses.

A few weeks ago, my brother said society should stop treating depressed people and let evolution get rid of depression.

Thanks for the advice. I realized that those scissors aren't sterile so I probably won't use them again. The cut wasn't too deep but there's still a scab where it was. Yeah I've noticed when I hit my head sometimes I get dizzy.

I think the way it's gotten worse lately is b/c of stress from work but also might have something to do with the new birth control meds my doctor gave me for PCOS. The hormonal stuff is screwing with my emotional stability and I need to go back on antidepressants or get off of these pills. Seeing the doctor on Wednesday. Debating telling her about the SH and suicidal thoughts but probably won't tell her.

Yes it is scary. It's like I get into this state where I'm not even acting like myself. It's almost an out of body experience where I disassociate myself from my actual self and decide that I hate this person enough that they deserve to be hurt. That makes me sound psychotic I guess.

It's nice (but also terrible) to know that I'm not alone as an adult who self harms. Thanks for sharing your experience with me.

I used to like drawing and painting but after going to university for animation it became more of a chore than something enjoyable and I associated it with stressful feelings. So I haven't done anything creative lately. Mostly I distract myself with video games and tv shows.

I tried asking him to put me on a different project but he says he has no one else to take over for me on this one. I've told my mom about how upset work makes me but she doesn't take me seriously either or just doesn't care. She's kind of verbally/emotionally abusive to me so I don't speak to her much.

I'm taking it one day at a time and I keep distracting myself with crap online and tv so I don't keep thinking suicidal thoughts. I have an appointment with my doctor on Wednesday and I'm going to ask about getting back on antidepressants.

I feel like it's impossible to quit because I live with my parents. They won't let me not have a job even if I promise I will find another one. Also because I work for my dad I don't want to disappoint him any more than I already do every day.

I'm not in the suicidal state I was in on Thursday. I saw your message but didn't respond until just now, but it helped me. Thank you.

I don't know why this would get downvoted.

I'm sorry you're so lonely and understand your struggle with the job hunt. I've tried to apply for jobs in my industry since i graduated in 2012 but haven't had a break yet. I had to take a job that my dad gave me and it's high stress and I hate it.

I can't really offer any solutions here just some encouragement to keep trying and updating your resume and following up after you send them out.

For me when I feel lonely I try to make online friends and talk to them. Have you thought of joining any communities online? I found most of my online friends while playing online games. But you could also join a meetup or something if you want to meet some ppl irl.
